decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - Development shall be constructed using the materilas approved under decision reference 00455/19/P5(2,5,8) dated 06/06/2017.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Design & Access Statement, Flood Risk Assessment, Hard and Soft Landscaping Plans, L01, P01, P02, P03, P05, P06, Hydro-Geological Assessment and Soil Report, Construction Method Statement, External Surface Materials Proposals Report, Received: 13/04/2017. P07-A, P04-A, Received: 17/05/2017) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - DThe development shall be landscaped in accordance with the landscaping design approved under decision reference 00455/19/P5(2,5,8) dated 06/06/2017.
Condition : 6 - The basement shall at no time be used or occupied as a separate dwelling independent of the main house and shall not be used as sleeping accommodation.

Condition : 7 - No development shall be carried out until such time as the person carrying out the work is a member of the Considerate Constructors Scheme and its code of practice, and the details of the membership and contact details are clearly displayed on the site so that they can be easily read by members of the public.
Condition : 8 - Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved Construction Method Statement approved under decision reference 00455/19/P5(2,5,8) dated 06/06/2017.
description: Creation of a basement with a front lightwell and walk-on rooflights to the rear of the house.
